mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by >10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth falls by >10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) both decline simultaneously, it signals an overheating labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 55, indicating a strong expansion in manufacturing activity, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a favorable growth-inflation mix that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by >3% year-over-year, it signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2% and Y/Y CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.
